rubric.statement: The answer must show that `OpenAIProvider.finetune` strips the `openai/` provider prefix before starting remote training, so a provider-qualified inference name is converted to the bare model ID first.

The proof should patch or stub `OpenAIProvider._start_remote_training` and capture its `model` argument, because that argument is the exact model string DSPy forwards into the OpenAI fine-tuning job creation call.

To keep the program offline while still exercising `OpenAIProvider.finetune`, it should stub the provider-facing steps that `finetune` invokes around the job lifecycle, including upload, remote training start, waiting, and trained-model retrieval.

The program should assert that the captured remote-training model is the stripped bare ID for the chosen prefixed input (for example, `openai/gpt-4o-mini` becomes `gpt-4o-mini`) and also assert that `finetune` returns the mocked trained-model value from `get_trained_model`.
